title: Add a Business Validation Rule
readerIntent: Implement a reusable validation rule in the correct owner and extension layer.
priorKnowledge: Know the schema, operation, lifecycle, and caller types.
owner: The capability that owns the protected business invariant
summary: Express declarative constraints in schema metadata and behavioral invariants in an owned validator or interceptor reached by every mutation path.

sections.heading: Example: employee activation
paragraphs: Suppose an Employee may become active only when required identity and enterprise relationships are valid. Required field and relationship shape belong in schema validation. The cross-record activation invariant belongs in a profile-owned service or save interceptor. Axis may explain the missing information, but it cannot be the only enforcement point.

sections.heading: Implementation steps
items: State the invariant, owner, affected operations, caller types, and expected failure code.
Check for an existing declarative constraint, validator, interceptor, pipeline node, or policy contract.
Put configurable thresholds, group mappings, and enablement in layered properties rather than closure constants inside schemas.
Implement at the narrowest owned backend boundary reached by API, import, workflow, job, assistant, and internal calls.
Register stable status definitions and safe messages.
Document customization, security, observability, and operational implications.

sections.heading: Test matrix
items: Positive valid transition.
Negative missing, malformed, unauthorized, and invalid-state requests.
Minimum, maximum, empty, duplicate, immutable, and relationship boundaries.
Human, service-to-service, and scheduled-process authentication boundaries where applicable.
API, import, workflow, event, job, and direct service contract integration.
Regression for existing records, normal schema updates, and unaffected capabilities.

sections.heading: Specify the invariant
items: An Employee cannot become active without required identity data.
The Employee must belong to an accessible Tenant and eligible Enterprise.
Only authorized employee groups may activate it.
Already active records follow the documented idempotent or conflict behavior.
The rule applies to every mutation path.

sections.heading: Separate rule components
paragraphs: Required field types remain declarative schema constraints. Cross-record completeness and lifecycle transition belong in a Profile-owned validator or save interceptor. Group mappings and enablement belong in Profile properties when projects may refine them.
Axis supplies guidance and disables obviously invalid actions for usability, but the backend remains authoritative.

sections.heading: Register the failure contract
items: Choose a stable Profile-owned error code.
Map it to the correct response classification.
Provide safe context such as missing field names only when allowed.
Supply user-facing localized text through content or presentation contracts.
Add monitoring guidance without exposing identity data.

sections.heading: Exercise every caller
items: Employee API and Axis Schema Workbench.
Core or project data import.
Workflow automatic action.
Scheduled cleanup or activation job.
Internal service call and governed AI tool.
Any administrative bulk operation.

sections.heading: Failure and rollback tests
items: Missing identity and invalid Enterprise relation.
Unauthorized actor and wrong tenant.
Concurrent change and already active state.
Database or relationship-service outage.
No event, cache change, or search update after rejection.
Transaction rollback or compensation for partial work.

sections.heading: Customization proof
paragraphs: Create a project-layer configuration that adds a permitted group or enables an additional completeness rule. Prove default Profile behavior without the project and refined behavior with it.
Do not copy Employee schema, duplicate activation service, or place the only validation in Axis.

sections.heading: Completion evidence
items: Source owner and extension point documented.
Stable status registered and rendered safely.
Positive, negative, boundary, integration, and regression tests passing.
Metrics and safe trace context verified.
Beginner and developer documentation updated.
Generated API, test, and AI context refreshed.
